whyMatters.heading: Why Professional Airbnb Cleaning Protects Your Listing
body: On platforms like Airbnb and Vrbo, cleanliness is the single most-reviewed category by guests. A single low cleanliness score can suppress your listing in search results, reduce booking rates, and damage a reputation built over months or years.

Professional short-let cleaning is not simply about tidiness — it is about consistency. Every guest expects the same standard, every time. Cleaniq Services' Airbnb cleaning team in Manchester follows a fixed turnover protocol so your property meets the same high standard whether it is your first guest or your five-hundredth.

Beyond cleanliness, our turnover team also checks for unreported damage, missing inventory, and maintenance issues — giving you the information you need to protect your property and resolve any disputes with your hosting platform.

faqs.q: How quickly can you turn over an Airbnb property?
faqs.a: Most one and two-bedroom properties can be turned over within 2–3 hours between check-out and check-in. Larger properties are quoted individually. We work to your specific check-in time.

faqs.q: Do you provide linen and towels?
faqs.a: We can launder linen and towels on-site if your property has a washing machine and dryer. We can also coordinate with a linen service if you require off-site laundering.
Yes. We work with Manchester Airbnb hosts managing single properties and large portfolios alike. We can coordinate across multiple properties and integrate with your Airbnb calendar.

faqs.q: What happens if a guest causes damage?
faqs.a: Our team photographs and logs any damage discovered during the turnover and notifies you immediately — giving you documentation to support a claim with Airbnb or your insurer.

faqs.q: Do you cover all Manchester Airbnb areas?
faqs.a: Yes. We cover all Greater Manchester postcodes including City Centre, Salford, Didsbury, Chorlton, Fallowfield, Stretford, and surrounding areas.

faqs.q: What is included in an Airbnb turnover clean?
faqs.a: Every turnover covers the kitchen, bedrooms, bathrooms, living areas and hallways: surfaces wiped, floors vacuumed and mopped, bathrooms cleaned, beds made with fresh linen, towels folded and bins emptied. The full Airbnb turnover cleaning checklist is on this page.

faqs.q: How much does Airbnb cleaning cost in Manchester?
faqs.a: The price depends on the size of your property and what it needs. Book online to see your price before you pay, or contact us for a free quote if you manage several properties.

faqs.q: Do I need to be at the property during the clean?
faqs.a: No. Just tell us how our cleaner can get in, for example a key safe or smart lock code, when you book.
Yes. Every Cleaniq Services cleaner is vetted and background checked before their first job.

faqs.q: What if I'm not happy with the clean?
faqs.a: Tell us within 48 hours and we'll send a cleaner back to put it right, free of charge.

faqs.q: Do you clean holiday lets and serviced apartments too?
faqs.a: Yes. Our short-let cleaning covers Airbnb, Booking.com and Vrbo listings, holiday lets and serviced apartments across Greater Manchester.

faqs.q: Can I add a deep clean or carpet cleaning to my Airbnb clean?
faqs.a: Yes. Add a deep clean, oven cleaning or carpet cleaning when your property needs more than a turnover. Book online or ask us when you call.

faqs.q: Can you clean on the same day as check-out and check-in?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us your guests' check-out and check-in times when you book and we'll plan the clean to fit between them. Book early for busy weekends and event days in Manchester.

faqs.q: How often should I deep clean my Airbnb?
faqs.a: Most hosts book a deep clean every few months, depending on how busy the property is. A deep clean reaches the areas a turnover clean can't cover between guests, such as inside appliances and cupboards and behind furniture.

faqs.q: Can you clean my property before I list it on Airbnb?
faqs.a: Yes. Book a deep clean before your first guest arrives, so your property starts spotless and your listing photos show it at its best.

faqs.q: Can my Airbnb co-host or property manager book the cleaning?
faqs.a: Yes. Anyone who looks after your Airbnb can book Airbnb cleaning with us online or by phone. Just make sure they share the check-out time, check-in time and access details for the property.

faqs.q: Do you clean Airbnb properties after a long stay?
faqs.a: Yes. After a long Airbnb stay, a standard turnover may not be enough. Book a deep clean to reset the property before your next Airbnb guest arrives.
